title: youtube.source.discovered payload (v1)
description: Payload of the youtube.source.discovered outbox event (docs/YOUTUBE_SOURCE_SYNC/SOURCE_SYNC_CONTRACT.md :: Event topics). Producers: app/knowledge_acquisition/acquisition_requests.py::AcquisitionRequests.enqueue for request-backed discoveries and app/knowledge_acquisition/playlist_discovery.py for traced discover-only dispositions. Idempotency key basis: (topic, binding_id, item_ref), so re-discovery of the same item in the same source dedups. Lineage posture: no dispatched consumer.
